versions.subject: New/Update Rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    OriginalFileName: 'Plink'
filter:
    Image|endswith: '\plink.exe'
condition: selection and not filter

versions.subject: Update proc_creation_win_renamed_plink.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
    OriginalFileName: 'Plink'
filter:
    Image|endswith: '\plink.exe'
condition: selection and not filter

versions.subject: refactor: plink usage / tunneling
versions.detection:
selection:
    - OriginalFileName: 'Plink'
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' -l forward'
        - ' -P '
        - ' -R '
filter:
    Image|endswith: '\plink.exe'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: OriginalFileName="Plink" OR (CommandLine="* -l forward*" CommandLine="* -P *" CommandLine="* -R *") NOT Image="*\\plink.exe"
